# Crazy SEO Team

> AI SEO, semantic SEO, NLP, GEO, AEO, LLM optimization and digital growth platform.

## About
Crazy SEO Team helps businesses improve visibility across Google Search and modern AI-powered search experiences. The site covers SEO, AI SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), LLM optimization, semantic SEO, NLP, technical SEO, content optimization, AI automation and digital marketing.

## Core Topics
- SEO and technical SEO
- AI SEO and AI search optimization
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
- Large Language Model (LLM) optimization
- Natural Language Processing (NLP) and semantic SEO
- Content writing, article writing and ghostwriting
- AI automation, AI agents and AI chatbots
- SEO tools, website audits and digital analytics
